method.description: Actual source and all chronological contact sheets inspected using view_image. Evenly spaced frames include 0, 4 and last. CPU FFmpeg decoding, filtering and PNG encoding limited to two threads each; no GPU or generation submission.

observations: The face-free aeroplane source has coherent wings, tail, canopy, nose and landing gear with meaningful contrasting broad colours.

Across 32 samples the orange two-blade propeller changes orientation around its hub and the aircraft gently bobs. Wings, tailplanes, green fin, canopy and wheels stay attached and recognizable; no sudden structural loss or new faces is observed.

The complete aircraft remains inside the frame in sampled views, including frame 123. Both clouds persist, but the right cloud drifts toward the right edge and is partly cropped in later samples; this is a minor background-framing caveat, not loss of the aircraft.
Main source colours and composition remain recognizable. Sampled motion progression is readable, with no obvious abrupt aircraft deformation.
limitations: Sampled still-frame inspection, not real-time playback or inspection of every frame. Motion observations describe progression across samples; frame-perfect smoothness, inter-sample artifacts and seamless looping are not guaranteed.
Contact sheets use reduced-size frames; full-resolution extracted samples are retained beside them.
scope: Exact-source and exact-video sampled visual reward-video review only. No painting processing, build, emulator, imports or integration performed or approved.
